accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

target_slot_registered_before.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot before supplyToBlp is called

hypercore_slot_active_after_action.meaning: HyperCore has activated the 0x811 supplied-balance slot after the accepted action
hypercore_slot_active_after_action.checkpoint: after the accepted action, before Accountant reads

accountant_reads_and_settlement_revert.meaning: Accountant backing/surplus reads and settlement revert until cleanup
accountant_reads_and_settlement_revert.checkpoint: after supplyToBlp registration, during Accountant reads and settlement

assumptions: The target BLP slot is the 0x811 supplied-balance slot referenced by the report.
The accepted action is the action 15 send performed by supplyToBlp.
Accountant backing/surplus reads and settlement are the operations that dereference the registered slot.

unresolved.description: Report states the inactive-slot outcome only as a possibility ('HyperCore leaves the slot inactive'); the potential modality of the impact is preserved by treating the inactive slot as a scenario condition rather than an established prior fact.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan formalizes the report-supported conditional scenario in which the slot remains inactive after the accepted action.
No unauthorized-caller condition is asserted by the report, so none is encoded.
Timing of HyperCore activation relative to notifyVaultSupply is not specified; the checkpoint is after the accepted action and before Accountant reads.
